title: Fractured Cinema Apocalypse
description: A woman in a blue and yellow vault suit stands in the center of a crumbling, burning movie theater, holding a film case in one hand while reaching toward a glowing green portal. The walls are torn apart revealing a post-apocalyptic desert with a nuclear mushroom cloud, film reels, movie posters labeled 'Fracture' and 'Stasis', and burning film strips.
